$Comment: Weakpoint node. Renders the ore item's own model and texture but is a real damageable entity, which a dropped item entity cannot be because those are intangible. The model and textures are bundled copies under Items/ because ModelAsset only accepts Characters/, NPC/, Items/ and VFX/ as roots, and the vanilla ore art lives under Resources/. HitBox is the mesh's own bounds measured by tools/measure_ore_model.py at the 32 units/block grid that block art uses, authored at unit scale; the variant's WeakpointScale grows it, and the spawner reads its centre back so a node sits on its socket instead of hovering above it.
